title: Remote command authorization flow
purpose: Verify each remote command, enforce local policy, execute only approved capabilities, and report bounded results.
entry_condition: A paired device receives a command request.
authority: The local PC agent policy engine is the final execution authority.

transitions.action: verify envelope signature, freshness, and nonce
side_effects: record accepted nonce after successful verification

transitions.action: resolve allow, deny, or explicit user approval
execute only an approved structured capability
return bounded result and audit metadata
side_effects: append audit event when audit subsystem exists

invariants: denied command has no execution side effect
failure_behavior: return a bounded error result without executing denied commands
restart_behavior: restart-safe nonce replay protection remains OPEN until durable replay state or per-start session rotation is implemented
rollback_behavior: revert candidate commit if acceptance regression is confirmed
